content.text: 25. INSTALL REVERSE IDLER GEAR SHAFT STOPPER
Install the reverse idler gear shaft stopper and tighten the bolt.

content.component: Reverse idler gear shaft stopper bolt

content.description: Illustration showing removal of intermediate plate from vise with arrows pointing to bolts and plate

items: (a) Dismount the intermediate plate from the vise.
(b) Remove the bolts, nuts, plate washers and gasket.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of transmission case to intermediate plate using a plastic hammer

content.text: 27. INSTALL TRANSMISSION CASE TO INTERMEDIATE PLATE

items: (a) Align each bearing outer race and each shift fork shaft with the case holes.
(b) Using a plastic hammer, tap on the case to install it.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of bearing snap rings using snap ring pliers

content.text: Using snap ring pliers, install the two snap rings.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of front bearing retainer with gasket and application of liquid sealer to bolts

items: (a) Install the bearing retainer with a new gasket.
(b) Apply liquid sealer to the bolts.
